clips.title: The story
paras: In Dolanaar, Taming the Beast begins a night elf hunter’s trials with a wild Webwood Lurker. Dazalar lends an enchanted taming rod, and the hunter must win the spider’s trust through a bond with nature.

For the kaldorei, hunting means more than tracking prey or surviving in the wild. It binds a hunter to nature, which is greater than any mortal. Animals are independent creatures, not tools to bend to a hunter’s will. Dazalar teaches novice hunters to meet them with respect. Before gaining a lifelong beast companion, a hunter must master local wildlife through ancient techniques, never brute force.

Giant arachnids infest Teldrassil’s boughs, and Dazalar gives the hunter a taming rod. The hunter seeks a Webwood Lurker in the shadowed thickets, facing the venomous spider and its attacks while trying to reach it through empathy. A brief mental bond proves the hunter can commune with the World Tree’s eerie, skittering predators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: As a hunter, it is important to remember the responsibility you hold in your hands. Nature is not a power that can be bent to obey our desires; it is one that is to be respected and acknowledged as something stronger than your very existence.
Friend, you must prove your understanding of this before you will gain the ability to tame an animal to be your companion.
Your first task is to take this taming rod. With it, you will be able to tame a webwood lurker. Tame it, and practice your skills as a hunter.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You will learn, friend, and one day you will be a great adventurer.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend! You are quite a fast learner.
